results.title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3: Direct AI Voices in Plain Language, Control Every Word and Shift Emotion Mid-Sentence
results.content:
Fish Audio, one of the fastest-growing AI platforms building expressive text-to-speech, speech-to-text and voice cloning, launched Drama 3. This text-to-speech model lets developers, studios, and creators direct a voice performance instead of simply generating one. Users describe the desired tone, pacing, and character in plain language, then shape the performance with line-by-line precision until it’s right. [...] Built to give developers, studios, and creators unprecedented control over voice performance, Drama 3 is designed for a wide range of applications, including audio dramas and interactive media, audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, games and animation, AI companion experiences, and content creation platforms. A drama studio can direct a two-character argument as a single scene, an audiobook narrator can shift from calm to trembling mid-sentence, and a game team can fix even a single word of dialogue without re-rendering the clip. Simply put, the model turns voice AI from something teams generate into something they can easily direct and edit. [...] “Voice AI has gotten very good at generating speech. The next step is directing a performance,” said Rissa Cao, co-founder and CEO of Fish Audio. “Drama 3 is our most emotive and controllable model yet. It puts creators in the director’s chair: describe what you want in plain language, listen back, and adjust only the moments that aren’t working. That matters most in long-form projects like audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, where one wrong word shouldn’t mean regenerating a whole chapter.”

results.title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3 to Direct AI Voices and Edit a Single Word – Unite.AI
results.content:
Fish Audio is targeting those production problems with Drama 3, its new text-to-speech model announced on October 13. The company says creators can direct delivery in ordinary language, generate scenes with multiple speakers, and repair a selected segment of synthesized audio without regenerating the surrounding performance.

The most consequential feature may be the smallest edit: changing a single word while preserving the voice, mood, and rhythm on either side. For teams building audiobooks, dubbed content, games, or audio dramas, the value of a synthetic voice increasingly depends on how easily it can be revised.

## Giving a Voice Performance Direction [...] ## Giving a Voice Performance Direction

Drama 3 accepts descriptions of tone, pacing, and character, including instructions that change delivery within a sentence. A passage can begin calmly and become panicked, according to the announcement, rather than requiring a new generation for each emotional section.

“Voice AI has gotten very good at generating speech. The next step is directing a performance,” said Rissa Cao, Fish Audio’s co-founder and CEO, in the launch announcement. [...] ## Audio Inpainting: Fixing the Moment That Fails

Fish Audio describes Drama 3’s audio inpainting as a way to select a portion of an existing performance, update the instructions, and regenerate that segment while retaining the surrounding audio. Co-founder and chief scientist Shijia Liao says the model uses the sound on both sides of an edited word to make the replacement fit.

That is a different task from generating an isolated replacement line. The new audio has to connect to an established performance: its timing, intonation, and vocal identity all need to remain believable at the boundaries of the edit.

# Fish Audio Drama 3 lets AI voices change emotion mid-sentence

Fish Audio Drama 3

Fish Audio has launched Drama 3, a text-to-speech model designed to make AI-generated dialogue sound less like someone reading a script and more like an actual performance. Released on October 13th, the model lets creators control emotions, pacing, and vocal delivery using ordinary language.

## Overview

Fish Audio Drama 3 is Fish Audio's text-to-speech model built for direction, released on October 13, 2026 and available on Morphic. You tell it how a line should feel in your own words, and it performs the read, with sounds, pauses and word-level tags exactly where you place them. [...] ### Feeling that holds up

Tears under the words, anger held in check, a laugh that breaks a straight face. The hard emotions come through.

### Sounds and pauses on cue

A sigh, a breath, a laugh or a pause lands exactly where you put it in the script, and nowhere else.

### Tags on chosen words

Wrap a few words in whisper, emphasis, slow or another paired tag, and only those words change.

### A whole scene in one pass

Give up to nine characters their own voice and Drama 3 performs the full dialogue together, each line answering the last.

### 83 languages, any direction

Drama 3 speaks 83 languages, and you can write the direction in your own language, even when the line is in another.

## Hear the range

Tire tracks across a frozen lake stretching to the horizon at dawn [...] Which paired tags does Drama 3 support?

Seven: whisper, emphasis, soft, fast, slow, stress and forceful. Each one opens and closes around the words it changes, as in every team. Everything outside the tags keeps the line's direction.

Can Drama 3 voice a conversation between several characters?

Yes. Switch to Dialogue, give each character a voice, and write the scene line by line. Drama 3 performs up to nine distinct voices in one pass, with up to 10,000 characters across the scene, so each reply sounds like an answer to the line before.

How many languages does Drama 3 speak?

83, according to Fish Audio. The direction does not have to match the line: you can write [holding back tears] in Japanese, Spanish or Chinese above an English line, and the performance follows it.
